headline: BROWNING OUT POURS 186 ON THE LADDS WHILE KYLE PITTS REMEMBERS HE'S A TOP-5 PICK
subhead: Week 15 was a bloodbath, a tight-end resurrection, and a reminder that Tnicolle benches like she's allergic to points.
matchOfTheWeek: McBridesStrangeWhiteHock survived T swift's Baddies by 7.12 in the only matchup that wasn't decided by halftime. Trey McBride dropping 43.40 was the entire ballgame — meanwhile Tnicolle left Kirk Cousins and his 26.92 rotting on the bench like leftovers in a frat house fridge. Optimal lineup would've scored 168.44. She lost by 7.
powerRankingsShakeup: Rub My Chubb is suddenly cooking at 97.3% efficiency and looks like a real problem heading into playoffs, while The Good Ladds got pantsed for 42 and are quietly imploding right when it matters.
mainRecap:
Where to begin. Patrickreegs and Browning Out hung 186.78 on Mig56 — the highest score of the week — with Bo Nix going for 29 and Tony Pollard adding ANOTHER 18.20 from the bench just to twist the knife. The Good Ladds countered with Travis Etienne's 31.5 and then promptly benched 120% Kyler for 21.56. Mig, you literally nicknamed the man, USE HIM. Jacoby Brissett is sitting on your couch outscoring half the starting QBs in this league.

OnlyFants got a 44-burger from Trevor Lawrence and bullied Egbukkake by 28. Szara's squad — featuring The Mascot, QB1.02, and a small army of nicknamed scrubs — managed 117.60, which is what happens when 'WR1' Tillman and Erick None show up like their names suggest. Brutal week to be a Patriot stack.

Rub My Chubb absolutely curb-stomped Little Peckers by 48.70. BigD ran a 97.3% efficient lineup; 7BigPapi7 ran 117.58 and the lowest score in the league. Unc was not enough this week. Nothing was.

McBride's squad squeaked by Tnicolle in the only competitive game, and we already covered that disaster. Elsewhere, Stroud Boys got the performance of the week from KYLE FREAKING PITTS (51.10 — yes, fifty-one) plus 30 from The Prodigal Son and 29 from Darren Waller off the waiver gods. Bjewett wasn't even playing this week and still won the scoreboard.

QAmon got 41 from ShAmon-Ra and still left Troy Franklin's 20.80 on the bench — Kyle, you good? Christian McCalfinjury benched Mike Evans for 19.20 because of course he did, the team name is the strategy. And Nut Olave Your Face got Mustard's 29.5 in what was presumably a bye week mercy because nickcelli had nowhere to spend it.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 7, left 41 on the bench, including a 27-point Kirk Cousins — somewhere a fantasy analyst is crying.

weeklyAwards.title: Tight End Renaissance Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: Kyle Pitts 51, Darren Waller 29 — bjewett accidentally built the 2021 preseason wet dream.

weeklyAwards.title: Mercy Rule Violation
weeklyAwards.blurb: 97.3% efficient and a 48-point win over Little Peckers — BigD didn't beat them, he processed them.

weeklyAwards.title: Nickname, Don't Bench Him
weeklyAwards.blurb: 120% Kyler dropped 21.56 from the bench while Mig lost by 42 — the joke writes itself, then starts itself, apparently.
